lines.zh: 我提着裙角，走过石板路。
lines.en: I lift my hem and cross the flagstones.

lines.zh: 篮子压在胳膊上，我走得不快。
lines.en: The basket weighs on my arm; I don't walk fast.

lines.zh: 我绕开那滩水，鞋是新补的。
lines.en: I skirt the puddle; these shoes were just mended.

lines.zh: 我沿着城墙底下走，风小。
lines.en: I keep under the wall where the wind is less.

lines.zh: 我回头看了看，没人跟着。
lines.en: I glance back; nobody's following.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，数着还有几家。
lines.en: I stop at each step, counting the houses left.

lines.zh: 我把头发别到耳后，继续走。
lines.en: I tuck my hair behind my ear and walk on.
I hurry; it'll be dark soon.

lines.zh: 我拐进巷子，那里近一些。
lines.en: I turn into the alley — it's shorter.
I have to get back before the gates shut.
I steady myself on the wall; the stones are slick.
The soles of my shoes are worn thin.
I carry a lamp that doesn't reach far.
I step in mud and my boot's filthy.

lines.zh: 我站着，手一直抓着篮子。
lines.en: I stand with both hands on the basket.
I check the bell tower; still early.
Someone's arguing over there; I listen.
I pull my scarf up a little.
I'm counting the coins in my pocket.
The wind lifts my hem.

lines.zh: 面包还热着，我得带回去。
lines.en: The bread's still warm; it has to get home.

lines.zh: 我看着井口，想起以前的事。
lines.en: I look at the well and remember something.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西换了个手。
lines.en: I shift what I'm carrying to the other hand.

lines.zh: 远处有马蹄声，我抬了头。
lines.en: Hooves sound far off and I look up.
I mutter a curse under my breath.
I'm waiting for someone to finish work.

lines.zh: 街上空着，我攥紧了篮子
lines.en: The street is empty; I grip my basket.

lines.zh: 你是从外面来的，我看得出。
lines.en: You're from outside; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我往后退了半步，抓着篮子。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and grip my basket.
Who are you looking for? The town's small.
I don't know you; don't come closer.

lines.zh: 你身上有烟灰味，刚打完仗？
lines.en: You smell of ash — just out of a fight?
I turn my face away.

lines.zh: 你说话轻一点，墙里什么都能听见。
lines.en: Lower your voice; the walls carry.

lines.zh: 你要过夜，得去东边那家。
lines.en: If you need a bed, the house on the east side.

lines.zh: 我不卖东西，我只是路过。
lines.en: I'm not selling anything; I'm just passing.

lines.zh: 你的衣服破了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your clothes are torn; I noticed.
I have no weapon.
I can't give you anything, truly.

lines.zh: 我把篮子移到身前挡着。
lines.en: I move my basket in front of me.

lines.zh: 这片街区归领主管，小心点。
lines.en: The lord owns this quarter; mind yourself.

lines.zh: 我捂住胳膊，血从指缝里出。
lines.en: I clutch my arm; blood through my fingers.
I hit the ground and my basket flies.
Don't — I'm nobody.

lines.zh: 被你救下，我还没缓过来。
lines.en: You saved me, and I still cannot catch my breath.
I drag myself toward the wall.
My skirt is torn.
I bite my lip and stay quiet.
I pull myself up on the doorframe.
I still have to get home.
Bread? That costs coin.
I don't take things from strangers.
If you really mean it, I'll take it.
I weigh it; it's new.
This feeds my house for two days.
Don't bring it out here.
My brother would like this.
I'll keep it and share it when I'm home.
Steady your hands; I'm not snatching.
Thank you — I'll remember it.
Hey — watch where you're walking.
Your bump put me half a step back.
My basket's knocked over; things spilled.
I'm bending to gather them — don't step there.
Sorry, my mind was elsewhere.
I brush the dust off my skirt.
You're hard, like armour.
This alley is too narrow.
Go on ahead; I'm in no hurry.
My husband's still working outside the walls.

lines.zh: 我把晚饭留着，等他回来。
lines.en: I keep his supper waiting.

lines.zh: 有人一起，日子才过得下去。
lines.en: The days only work if there's someone with you.
I trim the lamp brighter.
I set two bowls on the table.
When he comes home he never says much.
I've mended his cuffs.
Neither of us has it easy.
At night I listen for the door.
The lamp is lit, so someone will come home.
I bend to pick up the fallen coin.
That's mine — I dropped it just now.
I put it back in the basket.
This nail will fix a chair.
Vegetables dropped on the ground — I still gather them.
I dust it off before keeping it.
This is heavy; I can't lift it.
I look and put it back.
Whose is this? I hold it up and ask.
I keep anything that's still useful.
Someone's looting over there.
I snatch up a wooden stick.
I drop my basket.
I put myself in front of the children.
I'm calling toward the street corner.
I plant my feet; I can't back off.
Someone's blocking the alley mouth.
I bolt the door, then open it again.
I pick a place I can hold.
I don't take my eyes off it.
I edge left, and it follows.
I'm waiting for the patrol.

lines.zh: 它要是扑，我就躲进巷子。
lines.en: If it lunges, I'm into the alley.
My hands shake, but I don't run.
I've heard that sound before.
I hold the stick across me.
It circles; I fall back to the corner.
I don't scream; screaming makes it lunge.
I swing the stick down.
I block with the basket.
I shove it with everything I have.
I kick its knee.
I fling a fistful of dirt at it.
That one connected.
I back to the door and grab the ring.
I bring the stick down on its arm.
I fall as well.
I push the door open; smoke still hangs inside.
I step out with a basket to buy food.
The street's empty — too quiet.
I tidy my hair and step out.

lines.zh: 屋顶缺了一块，能看见天。
lines.en: A gap in the roof shows the sky.
I keep close to the wall.

lines.zh: 有个孩子在哭，我过去看看。
lines.en: A child is crying; I go to look.
I don't know this town.
I close the door without locking it.
My shoes are covered in dust.
Fire catches my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我踩空摔下去，腿动不了。
lines.en: I fall through and my leg won't move.
Water floods my mouth and I can't get free.

lines.zh: 墙塌下来，我被压在下面。
lines.en: The wall comes down and I'm pinned.

lines.zh: 箭穿过袖子，钉在木门上
lines.en: The arrow went through my sleeve into the door.

lines.zh: 有什么东西在我身上爬。
lines.en: Something crawls over me.
I haven't eaten in two days.

lines.zh: 雷打在屋顶，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof and I curl up.
The road beneath me is gone.
